title: Type classes & instances
hints: README 'New syntax': each `instance` block defines the class's method(s) for one type, by pattern matching like any function.

value: one equation per coin. show: the value as text plus "¢". compare: compare coins by their value. describe for Bool: two equations; for Coin: build the sentence with show (value c); for lists: describe each element and join with ", ".
Other data: `show (Temp d) = show d ++ "°"` · `comparing length "ab" "c"` → GT · `intercalate " / " (map show [1, 2])` → "1 / 2".
`show coin = show (value coin) ++ "¢"` · `compare = comparing value` · `describe xs = intercalate ", " (map describe xs)`.
